Global Metadata
Introduce subtle harmonic movement and sustained textures to enhance the warm electronic atmosphere.

Vocal Details
N/A (Instrumental only). Maintain a very soft dynamic range throughout.

Arrangement
Intro: Piano establishes a simple, consonant chord progression. Main: Introduce slow, evolving arpeggios in the piano, layered with a very subtle, sustained analog synth pad underneath to add warmth. Outro: Gradually decrease the density of the piano and synth layers, allowing the initial motif to gently fade into silence for the spoken segment.
